caseName: Besadny v. Lac Courte Oreilles Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Indians
caseNameFull: Besadny, Secretary, Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources v. Lac Courte Oreilles Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Indians

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 7th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, and Justice Stevens would affirm the judgment.
